fact_check.claim: Spring 2027 pre-enrollment: graduate/professional/Cornell Tech Nov 10-12, seniors Nov 11-13, juniors Nov 16-18, sophomores Nov 17-19, first-years Nov 18-20, 2026
fact_check.note: Calendar table matches each window, starting 7:30 AM.

fact_check.claim: Add/drop opens Jan 19, 2027 (graduate 9 AM, seniors 12 PM), juniors Jan 20, sophomores Jan 21, first-years Jan 22 at 9 AM
fact_check.note: Matches calendar.

fact_check.claim: Last day to add (regular sessions) Feb 8, 2027; last day to drop or change grading basis Mar 22, 2027
fact_check.note: Matches; seven-week sessions have separate dates, as the article says.

fact_check.claim: Each pre-enrollment appointment runs 3 days and begins at 7:30 AM for all class rankings
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Continuing students pre-enroll for fall in late April and for spring in late November
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Each advisor approaches enrollment differently
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Clear your cache first and quit other browser windows
fact_check.note: Page says to clear the browser cache, quit the browser and all windows; article's paraphrase is slightly narrower but not contradictory.

fact_check.claim: Class Roster Scheduler is for planning your semester and reviewing the proposed schedule with your advisor
fact_check.note: Previous fix applied; page says plan your semester with the Scheduler and review the proposed schedule with your advisor.

fact_check.claim: You can place requests in the Shopping Cart before your appointment; Enrollment Dates section shows your times
fact_check.note: Supported.

fact_check.claim: Shopping cart does not save a seat; you must complete enrollment once your appointment is active; class details can change after adding to cart
fact_check.note: Supported.

fact_check.claim: Course offerings are subject to change; holds at top right of Student Center, some require action
fact_check.note: Holds-at-top-right and credit-limit statements confirmed; offerings-change wording appears in registrar guidance.

fact_check.claim: Permission number is entered in step 1; green checkmark in step 3 means enrolled
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Do not log in from multiple windows, browsers or devices; requests can be stuck in pending
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Logged out after more than 30 minutes of inactivity
fact_check.note: Previous fix applied (link added); page says inactive for more than 30 minutes you are logged out.

fact_check.claim: Colleges set their own maximum credits per semester
fact_check.note: Quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: Arts and Sciences: 22 credits good standing, 18 on warning status, petition, more than 22 only in serious extenuating circumstances
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: CALS: 22 credits per semester, 18 during pre-enrollment
fact_check.note: Page: unable to enroll in more than 22 credits per semester (18 credits during pre-enroll). Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Duffield Engineering: 20 credits, petition never more than 24, first-year petitions not approved
fact_check.note: Page: max 20; up to 24 in limited circumstances; never more than 24; a student in their first year or first semester as external transfer will not be approved. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: ILR: 18 credits; only listed situations such as one extra PE course; no petition otherwise
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Engineering cap lowered from 23 to 20 starting fall 2022
fact_check.note: Sun article confirms; dated history, also not the current-rule source (Duffield page is).

fact_check.claim: Error text 'Unable to add this class - term maximum exceeded' and 'Available seats are reserved. You do not meet the enrollment group criteria...'; page gives no fix for the latter
fact_check.note: Both errors present; no fix for the reserved-seats error.

fact_check.claim: Only a limited number of classes have online waitlists; wait list capacity 0 means no wait list
fact_check.note: Previous fix applied; quoted on page.

fact_check.claim: 'Wait list if class is full' checkbox; drop the class to leave a waitlist
fact_check.note: FAQ describes the Wait List box labeled 'Wait list if class is full' and leaving via a drop.

fact_check.claim: Drop, swap or edit grading options in Student Center with an active appointment, unless consent needed, class closed, time conflict, or over credit maximum
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: After the add deadline, contact your college or school registrar
fact_check.note: Page: reach out to your College or School Registrar office.

fact_check.claim: Email coursenroll@cornell.edu for unlisted errors
fact_check.note: Address appears on the linked FAQ page; previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Katherine Yao, a junior in Arts and Sciences, wrote in Nov 2021 that CS 1110 and MATH 1110 were classes she predicted would open during add/drop; recommends Coursegrab
fact_check.note: Matches; article now says 'predicted' and labels it one student's 2021 view.

fact_check.claim: Opening paragraph: 'the best-known student advice is to wait for add/drop, when seats often open'
fact_check.note: Generalization rests on one 2021 student column; softened by attribution as student advice and the body section is properly hedged. Minor, acceptable.

fact_check.claim: Registrar gateway-course guidance on waiting for add/drop
fact_check.note: Page returned 404 on 2026-11-07 (search lists it but it does not load). Article discloses it could not open the page and does not cite it as a source.

beats_top.query: cornell course enrollment strategy pre-enroll tips
beats_top.why: The top results are dated per-semester registrar PDFs (the Fall 2023 one no longer loads); ours gives current Spring 2027 dates by class year, credit caps by college, restricted-seat and waitlist handling, and when to wait for add/drop, in the first paragraph.
changes: Optional later: add the registrar gateway-course guidance once its page loads.
Optional later: add departments' own pre-enrollment restrictions (e.g. CS 4000-level majors only) with links.
